facts.fact: Parliament's justice committee said on 25 November 2026 that the Information Regulator has a sitting Chairperson, Adv Pansy Tlakula, whose term ends on 30 November, and interviewed five candidates for its vacancies under the Protection of Personal Information Act.

Parliament's justice committee said on 25 November 2026 that the Information Regulator under the Protection of Personal Information Act has a sitting Chairperson, Adv Pansy Tlakula, whose term ends on 30 November, and interviewed five candidates for vacancies.
